items.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 10, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: But it was still the 12-bar blues. ... the same music, you know it’s the same format. So the original R & B, rhythm & blues, was like popular music, 40s and 50s, and I mean the popular music not only blues stuff like Little Richard

ctx.x: Little Richard, okay, Little Richard. But it was still the 12-bar blues.
